Meaning: Actual Windows Terminal recordings of bounded command scheduling, typography and loading UI in all three styles; all styles use Strips with process-loopback game audio. Every observed world/automap notice is checked against independent saved-state fixture text/timer; eleven game checkpoints per run. Classic uses the IWAD bitmap; character styles use the terminal font. Typography is reviewed separately using samples. Recordings are loaded tests, not clean pacing trials, acoustic/device-latency measurements, or ordinary-input map completion.

SchedulingLifecycle.Meaning: Actual WGC/loopback saves in every style, ordered input and exact control/checkpoint coverage on the frozen scheduler. Source manifests match clean collector scripts and current source hashes. Passes do not cross control tics, but a guard reached at the end of a multi-command burst is separately identified only if present in traces. Queue reads precede publication, not atomic maxima. Realtime credits cover produced PCM rather than proof of speaker output. No clean pacing, acoustic, physical-input/resize, independent moving-world or campaign qualification claim.
